description.value:
A howling whirlwind descends on a point you can see within range, forming a 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder centered there. Until the power ends, you can use your action to move the whirlwind up to 30 feet in any direction along the ground; it sweeps up unsecured Medium or smaller objects not worn or carried.

The first time on a turn that a creature enters the whirlwind's space, or the whirlwind enters its space (including when it first appears), the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 kinetic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A Large or smaller creature that fails also must succeed on a Strength saving throw or become restrained by the whirlwind until the power ends, being pulled 5 feet higher within it at the start of each of its turns unless already at the top; a restrained creature moves with the whirlwind and falls when it ends, unless it has another way to stay aloft.

A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check against your force save DC, escaping and being flung 3d6 x 10 feet away in a random direction on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 7
